name: OOF Class Manager
description: A panel and a UML class diagram over the vault's classes: edit a class's characteristics, component fields and parents in one place, and push the consequences to the notes, templates and characteristic notes. Classes are instantiated and components are composed; adds file.isA(), file.hasA(), file.inheritsFrom(), file.ancestors(), file.isADistance(), file.hasADistance(), file.views() and file.classBase() to bases.
author: Claude
